raw_text: The viral 'surgical strike footage' is from a Bollywood film. The production house has issued a statement confirming the scenes are from their 2023 war movie. The film's director has also posted on Instagram showing behind-the-scenes footage of the exact scene. Please stop sharing movie clips as real military operations. It diminishes the real sacrifices of our armed forces.
clean_text: Bollywood news confirms viral footage is from 2023 war film. Production house and director both verified. Behind-the-scenes footage of exact scene available.
